format: NDCA Final withdrawal record (future verified NDCA profile)
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not an NDCA rule): a withdrawal after the Final starts is recorded by an authorized official with a closed reason code (injury or illness) and confirmed by a different person; no free text and no medical detail is collected; the record is insert-only evidence.
interpretation_notes: III.D.30 sets no evidence or confirmation duty; this is DanceFlow policy by owner decision OD-08 item 4. Role mapping for the confirmer is open (Q2). Design only: nothing implemented.
decision_refs: OD-08 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
